text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — signoff backlog for Q2 reviews just spiked. Export shows 14 managers still need to sign off, and ~6 of those are scheduled to be interviewing offsite this week. Can we triage? @people-ops :eyes:
PeopleOpsBot: Export generated: managers_missing_signoff.csv attached to thread.
Jon: I can pick up reviews for Eng infra and Eng runtime — have bandwidth tomorrow morning. Which teams are highest priority?
Maya: Thanks Jon. Highest priority = teams with calibration meetings on Thurs/Fri and any managers out on travel. I'll DM the CSV rows.
Priya: If someone else takes reviews, how do we mark "delegated" in the form so calibration captures it correctly? Don't want duplicate reviewer slots.
Maya: Good call. Steps to delegate in the form:
```
1) Open the manager review form -> "Reviewer assignments" section
2) Add the backup reviewer email and select "Delegated reviewer"
3) In comments add: "Delegated by <original manager name> — for calibration, see note"
4) Save and notify people-ops so we can reconcile before calibration
```
Liam: We're short on interviewers today; several hiring loops also pulling the same managers. Could we shift manager signoff deadline 48h to avoid clashes? That buys breathing room for reviewers.
Maya: I'm okay filing a one-time 48h extension, but need a count of how many delegation requests we'll have. If >10, extension preferred; if <10, we'll assign backups. Can managers who will be out reply with "out:dates" so we can tally quickly.
Jon: out: Thu-Fri (interview travel). Happy to cover those two teams on Fri AM.
Priya: out: Wed-Thu. I can delegate to Sam (copied in DM).
Liam: out: Thu.
Maya: Great — tally so far: 3 out. If folks don't respond in 2 hours we'll send manager-tagged reminder and start backup assignees. I'll also publish a short checklist for delegates (quick rubric + calibration note).
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled in 60 minutes to channel @people-ops for outstanding signoffs.
Priya: Can you paste the delegate checklist in thread when ready? makes onboarding easier.
Maya: Will do. Draft checklist (short):
- Confirm you were assigned as "Delegated reviewer" in form
- Review manager comments + core examples (3-5)
- Flag any rating disagreements in the comment box and ping manager
- Add "delegated:" prefix in your calibration notes
Priya: Perfect.
Jon: I'll start with Eng infra now and report back in this thread with completed TS updates. :thumbsup:
Maya: Thanks everyone — I'll file the 48h extension if count >10, otherwise we'll proceed with backup assignments. I'll post final plan here within 3 hours.
Priya: Thanks Maya.
Maya: (following up) People who delegated, please confirm the backup reviewer in the form by EOD so calibration export stays clean.
Jon: Confirmed for the teams I picked.
Maya: Closing loop for now — extension deferred for now, starting manual assignments for confirmed outs. Will post CSV of assigned backups when done. :white_check_mark:
